overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Klosters 6 Person Barrel Traditional Sauna offers a luxurious outdoor retreat designed for relaxation and wellness. Crafted from premium Pacific Cedar wood, this spacious sauna accommodates up to six people, making it perfect for family gatherings or social relaxation. The 8.0 kW stove with built-in controls ensures a soothing heat experience, reaching temperatures up to 190°F, ideal for muscle relaxation and stress relief. With its elegant bronze privacy tempered glass door and interior LED accent lighting, this sauna combines functionality with style, providing a serene escape in your backyard.

_raw.Product Ad-Copy: With a Golden Designs traditional barrel sauna, you can turn that dream of your very own home spa into a reality. Take the first step to a healthier life!
